name: mi20-arbo
description: MI20 Arbo — SharePoint-hosted replacement of Access BASE ARBO MI20 (PPD + bordereau)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @mi20/domain && npm run build -w @mi20/api && npm run build -w @mi20/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @mi20/domain --if-present && npm run lint -w @mi20/api --if-present && npm run lint -w @mi20/web --if-present
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @mi20/api" "npm run dev -w @mi20/web"
